📄 Privacy Policy & Professional Disclaimer (LogiQ)

1. Data Collection & Purpose: LogiQ collects the Device ID (Android ID) solely to link your local decision history and Premium status to your hardware without requiring a manual account. We do not collect personal identifiers such as names, physical addresses, personal emails, or sensitive financial data. All financial transactions are processed securely through Google Play Payments.

2. Data Deletion & Retention Policy: Users have full control over their data. To request the deletion of your account/data, follow these steps:
- In-App Deletion: Open LogiQ > Go to History > Tap Clear All. This action triggers an immediate and permanent removal of all decision records and device associations from our servers.
- Manual Request: You may also request data deletion by emailing logiq.app.contact@gmail.com.
Retention: Once the 'Clear All' action is executed, no data is retained. We do not keep backup copies of deleted decision history.

3. Use of Artificial Intelligence: LogiQ utilizes data processing algorithms (FDU Technology) to assist in decision-making. Data entered for analysis is processed privately and is not shared with third parties or advertising companies.

4. Investment Disclaimer (IMPORTANT): LogiQ is a technological support tool. The information generated does not constitute financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. Favio Daniel Diaz Vargas (LogiQ Developer) is not liable for any financial losses.
